Covers core business domains including Messenger, Docs, Base, Sheets, Calendar, Mail, Tasks, Meetings, and more, with 200+ commands and 19 AI Agent Skills.. This represents a significant trend in Go tooling for production systems. FDEs should understand whether this is a flash-in-the-pan or a genuine shift in how teams build AI systems.
